source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The JS authorization functions await logout then login before returning token.isLoggedIn. Native folder authentication remains a synchronous Boolean routine that directly checks/authenticates an NSS slot, and its folder callers stop on false. The commit prose describes a Promise/spin-loop bridge that the final source does not contain. Keep those actual receiver/completion paths separate; no native callback, responsiveness, OS-auth or crypto result was executed or paired.
title: JavaScript token awaits and native folder authentication keep different completion contracts
